## Release impact

<!-- Pick one, and add the matching entry under "## [Unreleased]" in CHANGELOG.md in this pull request. How to choose: docs/releases.md. The version itself is never changed here. -->

- [ ] **none**: documentation, tests, CI or a refactor with no visible change (no entry)
- [ ] **patch**: a fix or a security fix (`Fixed`, `Security`)
- [ ] **minor**: a feature or a visible change (`Added`, `Changed`)
- [ ] **breaking**: an administrator has to act (`Breaking`, with `### Upgrade notes`)

- [ ] Adds a database migration (say so in the upgrade notes: going back to an older image needs the backup)
